[[Image:TOPIC.jpg|right|320px|thumb|The basic TOPIC equipment without the power supply on display at [[Bletchley Park]].]]
The '''BID 770''' was a British-built electronic [[cryptography]] device, codenamed '''TOPIC'''. It was also used by Canada's foreign service under the codename '''TENEC'''. TOPIC was brought into service in 1977, and became obsolete in 1995.

TOPIC was used to protect telegraph traffic, and replaced the earlier mechanical system called [[ROCKEX]]. It could be operated in both on- and off-line modes. Weighing 65&nbsp;lb, the machine used [[diode–transistor logic]] instead of single transistors.
